purpose: Operational PAPER validation only. This technical sizing calibration cannot authorize broker connectivity, live order transmission or movement of real capital.
approvalReference: Operator instruction on 2026-09-23 to continue Fenice and complete PAPER validation; v3 is a technical PAPER-only calibration revision after detecting that the v2 EUR 100 probe size made the fixed simulated fee dominate TCA.
notes: The first v2 probe used EUR 100 reference notional. With the fingerprinted PAPER OMS minimum simulated fee of EUR 1.50 plus 5 bps adverse slippage, this mechanically implied about 155 bps implementation shortfall, above the 75 bps hard execution-quality limit regardless of market quality. V3 therefore targets at most EUR 300 and 3% of EUR capital per probe, with a EUR 250 TCA floor and 15% single-asset ceiling. At EUR 300 the deterministic fee+slippage baseline is about 55 bps; at EUR 250 it is about 65 bps, both inside the existing 75 bps hard limit while still leaving WATCH/quality gates active. The stager rotates toward the least-used eligible symbol, and every probe must still pass market-data quorum, decision data, portfolio risk, pre-trade risk, kill-switch, audit and reconciliation. LIVE and broker connectivity remain forbidden.
